help.category.crm.title: CRM & Contacts
help.category.crm.content:
Customer Relationship Management

The core of Vysify are Contacts (people) and Companies (organizations). Centralize every customer interaction — messages, deals, tasks, payments, and notes — in one place.

  • Contacts: Register clients with name, email, phone, job title, linked company, and custom fields. Use the Activities tab to log calls, meetings, and internal notes.
  • Companies (B2B): Group multiple contacts under one organization. See the total deal value and service history for the entire company consolidated.
  • Tags: Classify contacts as 'VIP', 'Hot Lead', 'Inactive' for fast segmentation in automations and filters.
  • Bulk Import: Drag a .CSV spreadsheet and map columns to import hundreds of contacts at once. The system detects and merges duplicates automatically.
  • Full History: On the contact profile, see all deals, messages (WhatsApp/email), pending tasks, payments, and chronological team notes.
  • Global Search: Press Ctrl+K on any screen to open instant search and find any contact, deal, or company in milliseconds.

Tip: Fill in the Lead Source field (e.g. 'Instagram Ads', 'Referral') on contacts to later analyze which channels bring the most customers in the Analytics dashboard.
help.category.pipelines.title: Sales Pipelines
help.category.pipelines.content:
Kanban Pipeline — Visual Funnel Control

The Kanban Pipeline displays all your open deals organized into columns (stages). Drag and drop cards to move a sale from first contact to close.

  • Deals: Each card represents a sales opportunity with value, associated contact, deadline, and owner. Fill in the value ($) so the AI can calculate revenue projections.
  • Funnel Stages: Create as many stages as you need (e.g., Lead → Qualification → Proposal → Negotiation → Closed). Configure colors and enable required fields per stage to ensure data quality.
  • Multiple Pipelines: Companies with different sales processes (e.g., B2B Sales and Direct Sales) can have separate funnels. Create at Settings → Pipelines.
  • Priority: Mark deals as 🔴 High, 🟡 Medium or 🟢 Low. High-priority cards are highlighted in the Kanban board.
  • AI Insights: Click the ✨ button at the top of the pipeline for a full analysis: bottlenecks, deals at risk of going cold, and next-step recommendations generated by AI.
  • Filters: Filter the Kanban by owner, creation date, or value to focus on what matters now.

Tip: Use the List view (lines icon) to see all deals in a table format and sort by value or due date.
help.category.inbox.title: Inbox & Messages
help.category.inbox.content:
Omnichannel Inbox — All Channels, One Screen

The Inbox centralizes 100% of your company's conversations: WhatsApp, Instagram Direct, and coming soon: Email and Web Chat. Multiple agents can serve simultaneously without conflict.

  • WhatsApp Cloud API: Receive and send text, audio, image, video, and PDF documents. Full emoji support and threaded replies. Set up at Settings → WhatsApp.
  • Instagram Direct: Manage Instagram Business DMs without leaving Vysify. Requires a Meta Developers App. Set up at Settings → Instagram.
  • Conversation Assignment: Click 'Assign Member' to direct a chat to the right agent. Or use Automations to do this automatically by tags, schedule, or keyword.
  • Autopilot (AI): Enable Autopilot so the AI responds automatically using your business context. Ideal for outside business hours. Agents can take over at any time.
  • AI Response Suggestion: Click the ✨ icon in the message bar and the AI will draft a reply based on conversation history and your company context.
  • Message Templates: Use pre-written responses with dynamic variables (e.g., {{contact.name}}) to reply in seconds. Configure at Inbox → Manage Templates.
  • Conversation Status: Move conversations between Open, Pending, and Resolved to keep the queue organized. 'Resolved' conversations remain accessible in history.
  • Google Calendar Scheduling: Propose meeting times and create Google Calendar events directly inside a conversation without leaving the Inbox.

Tip: Use the shortcut ⌘ + / (Mac) or Ctrl + / (Windows) inside a conversation to quickly open the Templates tab.
help.category.tasks.title: Tasks & Reminders
help.category.tasks.content:
Activity Management — Never Miss a Follow-up

Tasks ensure every commitment, callback, and follow-up is tracked and executed on time. They can be linked to Contacts or Deals to keep full context.

  • Create Tasks in Context: Inside a contact profile or deal card, access the 'Tasks' tab and click '+ Add'. The task will be automatically linked to that record.
  • Due Date & Owner: Define when the task must be completed and who is responsible. Members receive notifications before the deadline.
  • Priority: Classify tasks as High, Medium, or Low to manage team workload.
  • Central Task Panel: Go to 'Tasks' in the menu to see ALL tasks — yours and your team's. Tasks in red are overdue, yellow are due today.
  • Filters: Filter by owner, priority, due date, or linked deal/contact.
  • Completion: Check the checkbox to complete a task. The system automatically records the completion date and time on the contact's timeline.

Tip: Use Automations to create tasks automatically. E.g. 'When a deal enters Proposal Sent → Create task: Follow-up in 3 days for the responsible agent'.
help.category.custom_fields.title: Custom Fields
help.category.custom_fields.content:
Adapt the CRM to Your Business

Custom Fields let you add company-specific information to Contacts, Companies, and Deals. Build your ideal data structure without writing code.

  • Available Types: Free text, Number, Selection (dropdown), Multi-Select, Checkbox (Yes/No), Currency ($), URL, Phone, and Date.
  • Where They Appear: Configure if the field shows in 'Sales' (deals/contacts), 'Support' (inbox), or both. This ensures each team only sees what is relevant.
  • Mandatory Field: Mark as 'Required' to enforce filling it when saving a contact or deal. Prevents incomplete records.
  • Use in Filters: Custom fields appear automatically in Contact and Deal list filters.
  • Use in Templates: Access custom fields in automations and message templates using {contact.custom.field_name}.
  • Configuration: Access at Settings → Custom Fields. You can reorder fields by dragging and delete ones you no longer use.

Warning: Deleting a field permanently removes data already filled across all contacts. Do this with care.
help.category.automations.title: Automations & Workflows
help.category.automations.content:
Autopilot Productivity

Automations are 'If this happens → do that' rules. Build complex service and sales flows without writing code.

  • Available Triggers: New message received, Deal changed stage, Contact created, NPS answered, Charge paid/failed, Tag added to contact.
  • Conditions (Filters): Refine when the rule fires. E.g. 'Only run if contact has VIP tag' or 'Only between 9am and 6pm'. Combine conditions with AND/OR.
  • Available Actions: Send WhatsApp message, Send email, Reply with AI, Assign conversation, Create task, Move deal stage, Apply tag, Call webhook, Delay (wait up to 24h), Multiple sequential actions.
  • Simulator: Before activating, use the 'Simulator' to test the rule with a real contact and confirm everything works as expected.
  • Automation Logs: 'Logs' tab shows the last 20 executions: fired or not, and the reason. Essential for debugging issues.
  • SLA & Response Time: Create alert automations when a conversation goes unanswered for X minutes — never leave a customer waiting unknowingly.

Advanced Tip: Use the 'Multiple Actions' feature to build sequences: (1) reply automatically, (2) wait 2h, (3) if still no reply, create a task for the manager.
help.category.analytics.title: Analytics & Reports
help.category.analytics.content:
Real-Time Sales Intelligence

The Analytics module consolidates data from across the CRM into visual dashboards so you make decisions based on facts, not intuition.

  • Main Dashboard: KPI cards (Total Contacts, Open Deals, Revenue, NPS) updated in real time. Owners also see financial metrics from payments.
  • Conversion Funnel (Pipeline): Visualize which pipeline stage loses the most deals. The stage-to-stage conversion rate reveals hidden bottlenecks.
  • Performance by Seller: Compare number of deals closed, revenue generated, and average response time across team members.
  • WhatsApp Analytics: Volume of messages sent and received in the last 30 days per connected number. Identify peak service times.
  • Sales Trend: 12-month chart showing evolution of won deal revenue. Identify seasonality and growth trends.
  • Lead Sources: See where your customers come from (WhatsApp, Web Forms, CSV Import) to invest in the right channels.
  • Export: Click 'Export Report' to download a complete Excel file with all sales, tasks, and WhatsApp data.

Tip: Combine Vysify Analytics data with the Meta Ads Analytics dashboard to calculate your real advertising ROI.
help.category.integrations.title: Integrations & Webhooks
help.category.integrations.content:
Connect Vysify to Your Ecosystem

Vysify works as the central hub of your tech stack. Connect it to any tool via Webhooks, Zapier, Make (n8n), or direct API.

  • WhatsApp Cloud API: Connect unlimited WhatsApp Business numbers. Each number appears as a separate channel in the Inbox. Set up at Settings → WhatsApp.
  • Instagram Direct: Manage Instagram Business account DMs. Requires an approved Meta Developers App. Set up at Settings → Instagram.
  • Meta Ads: Connect your Facebook/Instagram ad account to monitor campaigns, CPL, and ROAS directly in the Meta Ads Analytics dashboard.
  • Google Calendar: Sync your calendar to propose time slots and create meeting events directly inside Inbox conversations.
  • Webhooks: Receive real-time notifications of any CRM event (new message, deal closed, NPS answered) at any external URL. HMAC signature support for security validation.
  • Zapier & Make: Connect to 5,000+ apps without code. Use a Vysify Webhook as a trigger or as an action inside your Zaps.
  • API Keys: Generate per-workspace API keys for proprietary integrations. Access at Settings → API Keys.

Tip: Use the Delivery Logs panel in Webhooks to monitor all deliveries and automatically retry on failure.
help.category.presets.title: 1-Click Setups
help.category.presets.content:
Industry Presets — Configure in Seconds

Presets are pre-built configuration packages for market segments. With 1 click you create Pipelines, Stages, Custom Fields, and Tags suited for your business.

  • Real Estate: Pipeline: Prospecting → Visit → Proposal → Closing. Fields: Property Type, Appraised Value, Area (m²), Neighborhood.
  • Clinics: Pipeline: Scheduling → Consultation → Follow-up. Fields: Insurance, Date of Birth, Medical Record Number.
  • Digital Agency: Pipeline: Proposal → Onboarding → Ongoing → Renewal. Fields: Contracted Package, MRR, Renewal Date.
  • Technical Support: Pipeline: Quote → Approved → In Progress → Delivered. Fields: Equipment, Serial Number, Warranty Until.
  • Restaurant/Events: Pipeline: Request → Quote → Confirmed → Completed. Fields: No. of Guests, Event Date, Menu.

Access at Settings → Industry Presets. You can apply multiple presets and customize every detail afterwards.
help.category.billing.title: Billing & Subscriptions
help.category.billing.content:
Plan Management & Credits

Track your current plan, resource usage, payment history, and make upgrades without service interruption.

  • Current Plan: See at Settings → Billing what plan you have and which modules are included (max users, contacts, AI credits, etc.).
  • Real-Time Usage: Progress bars show how much of each quota you've used: WhatsApp messages, AI credits, uploads, and number of contacts.
  • Plan Upgrade: Click 'Change Plan' to view all available plans. The change is instant via Stripe — no service interruption.
  • Additional Credits: Ran out of AI or WhatsApp quota before month end? Purchase add-on credit packs directly in Billing without changing plans.
  • Invoice History: Download PDF receipts and invoices for all your previous payments at Billing → Invoice History.
  • Free Trial: If you're in a trial period, a remaining days counter and a pre-expiry warning appear to avoid surprises.

Note: Early cancellation of an annual plan may be subject to a cancellation fee. Review your plan terms before canceling.
help.category.team.title: Team Management
help.category.team.content:
Secure Collaboration & Access Control

Add team members, define permissions, and maintain full control over who accesses what in your workspace.

  • Invite Members: Go to Settings → Team and click 'Invite Member'. The invitee receives an email to accept. If they don't have an account yet, they'll create a password in the process.
  • Roles: Owner: Full access including billing and settings. Admin: Manages automations, pipelines, and team. Member: Accesses only Inbox, Contacts, Deals and Tasks — cannot see financial data or configurations.
  • Invite Link: Generate a shareable link so anyone joins the team with a pre-defined role. Useful for mass onboarding.
  • Removing Access: Remove members at any time in Settings → Team. Access is revoked immediately and conversations assigned to the member become 'Unassigned'.
  • Data Visibility: Members with 'Member' role cannot see other sellers' data in reports — only their own deals and tasks.

Security Tip: Enable two-factor authentication (2FA) for all admins. Configure at Account → Security → 2FA Authentication.
help.category.ai_context.title: AI Training
help.category.ai_context.content:
Teach the AI About Your Business

The Business Context is the 'instruction manual' you give the AI. The more detailed, the more precise and personalized the generated responses — both in Inbox suggestions and Pipeline insights.

  • What to Include: (1) Full description of your products/services and pricing. (2) Target audience and main customer pain points. (3) Tone of voice (formal, casual, technical). (4) Competitive differentiators. (5) FAQs and standard answers. (6) Common objections and how you handle them.
  • Where to Configure: Access Settings → General → AI Business Context. The field accepts up to 10,000 characters of free text.
  • How It Affects Results: Without context, the AI generates generic responses. With a well-written context, it mentions your products by name, uses the right tone, and knows when to escalate to a human.
  • AI Conversation Summary: In the Inbox, click ✨ to generate a structured summary: customer problem, what was promised, and recommended next step.
  • AI Objective: When generating suggestions, choose the goal: 'Support', 'Qualify', 'Close', or 'Schedule'. This shapes the focus of the generated response.

Tip: Update the context whenever you launch a new product, change pricing, or shift your communication strategy to keep the AI aligned with business reality.
help.category.nps.title: NPS & Customer Satisfaction
help.category.nps.content:
Measure and Improve the Customer Experience

The NPS module lets you send automated satisfaction surveys and track customer loyalty over time.

  • Create Surveys: Go to 'NPS → Surveys' and click 'New Survey'. Define the name, opening message, and thank-you message.
  • Sending Channels: Send via WhatsApp (highest response rate) or Email. You can also generate a direct link to share manually.
  • Automated Sending: Use Automations to send surveys automatically. E.g. 'When a Deal is marked as Won → Send NPS survey 2 days later via WhatsApp'.
  • Analytics Dashboard: See the score distribution (0–10), count of Promoters (9–10), Passives (7–8), and Detractors (0–6), plus your company's overall NPS Score.
  • Responses: Access 'NPS → Responses' to see each individual rating with the score, comment, and customer data. Filter by score and period.
  • Automatic Alerts: Configure automations to notify the team when a low score (0–6) is received: 'Detractor received → Create urgent task for manager to call the client'.

Tip: NPS benchmarks vary by industry, but a score above 50 is considered excellent. Monitor the month-to-month evolution to identify the impact of process changes.
help.category.meta_ads.title: Meta Ads Analytics
help.category.meta_ads.content:
Ad Management — Facebook & Instagram

The Meta Ads Analytics module connects Vysify to Meta Business Suite, displaying data from all your Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns directly in your CRM — no need to switch between platforms.

  • OAuth 2.0 Connection: Click 'Connect Meta Ads Cloud' on the Ads panel. You'll be directed to authorize Vysify on Facebook securely. Your Facebook password is never shared — only an access token is saved.
  • Dashboard KPIs: Total Spend (last 30 days), Total Leads generated, average Cost per Lead (CPL), and ROAS (return on ad spend).
  • Performance Chart: See the evolution of daily ad spend in an interactive area chart. Identify spending spikes and correlate with lead increases in your CRM.
  • Campaign Report: Detailed table of each active or paused campaign: name, status, spend, leads generated, and individual CPL. Quickly identify which campaigns deliver the best ROI.
  • Multiple Ad Accounts: The system fetches all Ad Accounts linked to your Meta token. The maximum number of accounts depends on your plan.
  • Security: The access token is stored encrypted. You can disconnect at any time by clicking 'Disconnect' on the panel — this revokes access immediately.

Prerequisite: This module is available only on plans that include Meta Ads Analytics. If your plan doesn't include it, you'll see an upgrade screen. Contact your administrator for more information.
